teaser: The flickering tube light over the gym locker room bench keeps buzzing on and off, and nobody fixes it. You are life path 11, carrying intuition sharp enough to sense what a room hasn't said yet, and ESTP, built to move the instant that room gives you an opening. The two don't sit easily side by side. The 11 wants you still long enough to catch the signal; the ESTP in you is already halfway out the door, keys in hand. What's particular here is the speed mismatch: a flash of knowing arrives, and the instinct is to act on it immediately, before it has had time to become more than a hunch.
excerpt: The joke lands before the apology does.
